arxiv-2011-07795.title: Deep learning in magnetic resonance prostate segmentation: A review and a new perspective Journal: preprint
arxiv-2011-07795.creator: David Gillespie, Connah Kendrick, Ian Boon, Cheng Boon, Tim Rattay, Moi Hoon Yap
arxiv-2011-07795.description: Abstract Prostate radiotherapy is a well established curative oncology modality, which in future will use Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)-based radiotherapy for daily adaptive radiotherapy target definition. However the time needed to delineate the prostate from MRI data accurately is a time consuming process.

arxiv-2012-01930.title: Learning Explainable Interventions to Mitigate HIV Transmission in Sex Workers Across Five States in India
arxiv-2012-01930.creator: Raghav Awasthi, Prachi Patel, Vineet Joshi, Shama Karkal, Tavpritesh Sethi
arxiv-2012-01930.description: Abstract Female sex workers(FSWs) are one of the most vulnerable and stigmatized groups in society. As a result, they often suffer from a lack of quality access to care. Grassroot organizations engaged in improving health services are often faced with the challenge of improving the effectiveness of interventions due to complex influences.

arxiv-2205-12406.title: Multi-Head Online Learning for Delayed Feedback Modeling CCS: Computing methodologies Modeling methodologies CCS: Computing methodologies Online learning settings CCS: Computing methodologies Learning linear models
arxiv-2205-12406.creator: Hui Gao, Yihan Yang
arxiv-2205-12406.description: Abstract . In online advertising, it is highly important to predict the probability and the value of a conversion (e.g., a purchase). It not only impacts user experience by showing relevant ads, but also affects ROI of advertisers and revenue of marketplaces.

arxiv-2209-00319.title: Some old and basic facts about random walks on groups
arxiv-2209-00319.creator: Wolfgang Woess
arxiv-2209-00319.description: Abstract . This note contains old instead of new results about random walks on groups, which may serve as a supplement to the author’s monograph [ 15 ] . First, we exhibit a basic exercise on the periodicity classes of random walk.

arxiv-2301-13501.title: Auxiliary Learning as an Asymmetric Bargaining Game
arxiv-2301-13501.creator: Aviv Shamsian, Aviv Navon, Neta Glazer, Kenji Kawaguchi, Gal Chechik, Ethan Fetaya
arxiv-2301-13501.description: Abstract Auxiliary learning is an effective method for enhancing the generalization capabilities of trained models, particularly when dealing with small datasets. However, this approach may present several difficulties: (i) optimizing multiple objectives can be more challenging, and (ii) how to balance the auxiliary tasks to best assist the main task is unclear.

arxiv-2401-11467.title: Over-Reasoning and Redundant Calculation of Large Language Models
arxiv-2401-11467.creator: Cheng-Han Chiang, Hung-yi Lee
arxiv-2401-11467.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can solve problems step-by-step. While this chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning boosts LLMs’ performance, it is unclear if LLMs know when to use CoT and whether those CoT are always necessary to answer the question. This paper shows that LLMs tend to generate redundant calculations and reasoning on a manually constructed math QA dataset, GSM8K-Zero .

arxiv-2404-11048.title: Can near-to-mid infrared spectral energy distribution quantitatively trace protoplanetary disk evolution?
arxiv-2404-11048.creator: Mingchao Liu (刘明超), Jinhua He (何金华), Zhen Guo, Jixing Ge (葛继兴), Yuping Tang (唐雨平)
arxiv-2404-11048.description: Abstract Infrared (IR) spectral energy distribution (SED) is the major tracer of protoplanetary disks. It was recently proposed to use the near-to-mid IR (or K-24) SED slope α \alpha defined between 2-24 μ \mu m as a potential quantitative tracer of disk age.

arxiv-2407-01514.title: О спектральных задачах Колмогорова и Рохлина
arxiv-2407-01514.creator: в классе перемешивающих автоморфизмов
arxiv-2407-01514.description: Abstract Let T be a staircase rank-one construction with parameters r_{j}\sim j^{d} , 0<d<0.2 , then its spectrum does not have the group property, and the product T\otimes T has homogeneous spectrum of multiplicity 2. А. Н. Колмогоров еще давно высказывал предположение (см. например, [ 1 ] ) о том, что максимальный спектральный тип эргодического автоморфизма всегда подчиняет свою свертку.

arxiv-2409-02687.title: Horseshoes and spiral waves: capturing the 3D flow induced by a low-mass planet analytically
arxiv-2409-02687.creator: Joshua J. Brown, Gordon I. Ogilvie
arxiv-2409-02687.description: Abstract The key difficulty faced by 2D models for planet-disc interaction is in appropriately accounting for the impact of the disc’s vertical structure on the dynamics. 3D effects are often mimicked via softening of the planet’s potential; however, the planet-induced flow and torques often depend strongly on the choice of softening length.

arxiv-2502-14596.title: Fig. 1.
arxiv-2502-14596.creator: A planted plane tree with root label
arxiv-2502-14596.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A planted plane tree with root label. A note on plane trees with decreasing labels Tsun-Ming Cheung, Luc Devroye, and Marcel Goh School of Computer Science, McGill University Abstract. This note derives asymptotic upper and lower bounds for the number of planted plane trees on n nodes assigned labels from the set \{1,2,\ldots,k\} with the restriction that on any path from the root to a leaf, the labels must strictly decrease.

arxiv-2506-16176.title: Validity of generalized Gibbs ensemble in a random matrix model with a global ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} -symmetry
arxiv-2506-16176.creator: Adway Kumar Das
arxiv-2506-16176.description: Abstract ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry is ubiquitous in quantum mechanical systems where it drives various phase transitions and emergent physics. To understand the role of ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry in the thermalization of a local observable in a disordered system, we consider random symmetric centrosymmetric (SC) matrices where the exchange symmetry is conserved.

pmc-10476371.title: “Hospital survival of patients with pulmonary embolism in a country with limited resources case of the city of Kinshasa”
pmc-10476371.creator: Tshilanda Balekelayi Marc, Tshiasuma Pipo Michel, Mpembe Florence, Mujijo Tousaint, Kazadi Serge, Bosenedje Chadrack, Kokusa Roly, Dizolele Gédéon, Makanzu Madioko Brady, Kamangu Ntambue Erick
pmc-10476371.description: BackgroundPulmonary embolism is a frequent cause of intra-hospital mortality. The survival of patients depends not only on the speed of diagnosis but also on the treatment initiated.Objectiveto evaluate the intra-hospital survival of patients with pulmonary embolism in the city of Kinshasa.

pmc-11431937.title: Reducing Length of Hospital Stay Following Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
pmc-11431937.creator: Ahmed R. Gonnah, Arif A. Khokhar, Ji-Jian Chow, Adam Hartley, Rahul Sethi, Saud Khawaja, Nearchos Hadjiloizou, Neil Ruparelia, Ghada Mikhail, Iqbal Malik
pmc-11431937.description: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) has emerged as a safe and effective treatment for severe aortic stenosis across the spectrum of surgical risk cohorts. Subsequently, the dramatic increase in procedural volume worldwide has placed significant financial and logistical pressures on healthcare institutions, particularly regarding hospital length of stay (LOS), which can adversely affect patient flow.

pmc-11506594.title: Factors Associated with Multimodal Care Practices for Cancer Cachexia among Pharmacists
pmc-11506594.creator: Satomi Okamura, Koji Amano, Saori Koshimoto, Sayaka Arakawa, Hiroto Ishiki, Eriko Satomi, Tatsuya Morita, Takashi Takeuchi, Naoharu Mori, Tomomi Yamada
pmc-11506594.description: Pharmacists’ roles in cachexia care are unclear. This study aimed to clarify the knowledge and practice of cachexia care and identify factors related to the practice of cachexia care among pharmacists. Information on the knowledge and practice of cachexia care was obtained. Components of practicing multimodal care were evaluated.

pmc-12478245.title: Protocol for iterative in vivo selection of highly metastatic ovarian cancer cell populations and metastasis modeling in mice
pmc-12478245.creator: Yuqi Wang, Mangze Hu, Yilong Zou
pmc-12478245.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryThe molecular basis underlying ovarian cancers’ multi-route metastasis remains poorly defined. This protocol details iterative in vivo selection of highly metastatic cancer cell populations and metastasis modeling in ovarian cancer. We outline steps for inoculation of ES-2-GFP-Luc, monitoring tumor growth and visceral spread, isolation and culture of tumor-derived derivatives, reinoculation of ES-2-MC1-Hep to establish ES-2-MC2-Hep, and assessment of metastatic colonization efficiency.

pmc-12546755.title: Climate change is predicted to reduce global belowground ecosystem multifunctionality
pmc-12546755.creator: Tiancai Zhou, Jian Sun, Chongchong Ye, Xin Jing, Eryuan Liang, Xuyang Lu, Akira S. Mori, Michael E. Meadows, Josep Peñuelas
pmc-12546755.description: Although climate change is known to abruptly shift ecosystem functions in drylands worldwide, the global response of belowground ecosystem multifunctionality (BEMF) to future climate change remains largely unknown. Herein, we use fifteen indicators associated with key ecosystem functions (e.g., belowground productivity, nutrient pools and cycling) to evaluate global BEMF by averaging, principal component analysis, and single-threshold approaches.

pmc-12831318.title: A waterborne gastroenteritis outbreak caused by norovirus GII.9[P7] in Guangdong, China
pmc-12831318.creator: Caixia Li, Yingtao Zhang, Biao Zeng, Qiong Huang, Bixia Ke, Wei Zhang, Hanri Zeng, Jing Lu, Baisheng Li
pmc-12831318.description: BackgroundNoroviruses are a predominant cause of acute gastroenteritis (AGE) outbreaks globally, many outbreaks are associated with waterborne transmission. However, waterborne AGE outbreaks caused by the GII.9[P7] strain are relatively rare.MethodsIn April 2024, an AGE outbreak occurred among high school students on an educational excursion in Guangdong, China.

pmc-13094174.title: Molecular detection and phylogenetic characterization of pathogenic and endosymbiont microorganisms in Hyalomma ticks collected from livestock
pmc-13094174.creator: Nighat Perveen, Daniil Iliashevich, Khalid Muhammad, Mourad Ben Said, Naganeeswaran Sudalaimuthuasari, Khaja Mohteshamuddin, Adnan Aldarwich, Olivier Andre Sparagano, Uday Kishore, Arve Lee Willingham
pmc-13094174.description: BackgroundHyalomma ticks serve as vectors for a range of pathogens and harbor endosymbiotic bacteria that influence tick biology and the dynamics of pathogen transmission. In the United Arab Emirates, Hyalomma dromedarii and H. anatolicum are prevalent on livestock; yet, limited data exist on their microbial communities.

pmc-13205093.title: Sex-Specific Epigenetic Patterns in Endocannabinoid System Genes Following High-Altitude Exposure: An Exploratory Study
pmc-13205093.creator: Carlotta Marrangone, Alessio Mosca, Manuel Marzola, Francesca Martella, Martina Di Bartolomeo, Vittore Verratti, Giovanni Martinotti, Claudio D’Addario
pmc-13205093.description: Highlights What are the main findings? High-altitude related stress may be associated with sex-specific epigenetic differences in the endocannabinoid system, with male-specific increases in CNR1 promoter methylation.Changes in CNR1 methylation and stress-related miRNA expression suggest a modulation of CB1 signaling during extreme environmental exposure. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13374906.title: Developing comprehensive perinatal quality of care instruments in Mexico: An inclusive, multidisciplinary, and culturally sensitive approach
pmc-13374906.creator: Jimena Fritz, Pablo Montero-Zamora, Cara B. Safon, Pablo Martínez-Garrido, Matthias Sachse-Aguilera, Hernán García, Paola Sesia, Raffaela Schiavon, Héctor Lamadrid-Figueroa
pmc-13374906.description: Ensuring high-quality care during pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum, and the newborn period is essential for reducing maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality. In Mexico, a significant gap exists in comprehensive, culturally relevant instruments to assess quality of care (QoC) across these critical stages.

pmc-13535536.title: Immunohistochemistry as a tool for identifying PDGFRA amplification in central nervous system tumors
pmc-13535536.creator: Arnault Tauziède‐Espariat, Guilhem Amargos, Farah Sassi, Lauren Hasty, Alice Métais, Pascale Varlet
pmc-13535536.description: PDGFRA gene amplification is now recognized as a diagnostically and prognostically relevant molecular alteration in central nervous system tumors. Herein, we demonstrated that PDGFRA immunohistochemistry is a highly specific and sensitive biomarker for identifying PDGFRA amplification and should be part of the neuropathologist's routine panel of antibodies.

pmc-13600928.title: Effect of muscle fatigue on cycling asymmetry during a constant-power test
pmc-13600928.creator: Shahram Rasoulian, Seyed Hamidreza Heidary, Reza Ahmadi, Samira Fazeli Veisari, Walter Herzog, Amin Komeili
pmc-13600928.description: Asymmetry in cycling may reduce mechanical efficiency and increase the risk of overuse injuries, particularly as fatigue develops. While asymmetry is often assessed using global power output, analyzing directional force components may reveal biomechanical patterns more relevant to performance and injury.

uslaw-usc-t16-s460hh2.title: 16 U.S.C. § 460hh–2 — Establishment of hunting and fishing zones; exceptions; consultation with State agencies
uslaw-usc-t16-s460hh2.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s460hh2.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XCII (Chickasaw National Recreation Area). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall permit hunting and fishing on lands and waters within the recreation area in accordance with applicable Federal and State laws: Provided, That he may designate zones where, and establish periods when, no hunting.
